purpose: Offline engineering reference and target object compilation only

maximumSpeedMps.basis: Below 0.4515 m/s braking bound from the assumed near horizon and 0.4 m/s^2 planning deceleration; not measured.

lateralAccelerationMps2.basis: Conservative design scenario: 0.2 m/s at radius 0.2 m; no grip measurement.

accelerationMps2.basis: Reference 0 to 0.4 m/s in at least 0.8 s before jerk ramp.

brakingDecelerationMps2.basis: Shaper braking limit 0.8; 0.4 m/s constant-deceleration distance 0.1 m, plus delay/jerk distance; no physical brake data.

latencyS.basis: Assumed total pipeline design budget, not the measured capture-to-output latency and not certified by the 100 ms frame watchdog.

nearPreviewM.basis: Artificial metric horizon; no ground homography or measured near visibility exists.

fullPreviewM.basis: Artificial metric horizon for the same deterministic scenarios.

distanceMarginM.basis: Design reserve for sensitivity tests, not measured localization uncertainty.

farBudgetMs.basis: Finite episode used for software state-transition experiments; no P99 coverage claim.

farDistanceM.basis: maximumSpeedMps * farBudgetMs / 1000; must later be replaced by measured session statistics.

nearWindowMs.basis: Taskbook candidate for zero-drive near recovery; not a calibrated production threshold.

nearFrames.basis: Existing startup / taskbook candidate; distinct fresh frames required.

farFrames.basis: Three fresh frame confirmations for the software scenarios; not estimated from error runs.

stopTimeoutMs.basis: About 0.4/0.8 + 0.8/3 + 0.1 + 1.0 s rounded up to 2 s; the 1 s allowance is synthetic.

encoderWheelCprHypothesis.basis: Only if the nominal 1024 label means A-rising counts per wheel revolution and mechanical ratio is 1. These assumptions are NOT confirmed.

piKpQ8.basis: Existing route Kp=1; does not identify a new metric controller.

piKiQ8.basis: Existing 0.05 input quantized to 12/256 per nominal 10 ms.

plantFreeSpeedMps.basis: Fictitious PWM-to-speed first-order plant, NOT actual motor data.

planningDecelerationMps2.basis: Explicit 0.4 m/s^2 reserve below the 0.8 m/s^2 shaper limit. Coupled replay exposed a boundary failure with equal limits and encoder quantization; reserve is a design experiment, not measured robustness.

notes: Unknown real wheel CPR and rolling circumference remain null in the geometry baseline.
Reference policy values do not modify MIDTERM_C26_31 or authorize hardware motion.
All simulated measured speeds, stop distances, PI/PWM and tracking errors must retain simulation provenance.
